title: Nuns with Guns Update:
author: Romellija
selftext:
Hi all

With the release of OPUS 5.5 AND ASTRA. It has really progressed my work on Nuns with Guns so much so that I've turned it into an 3rd person shooter with a linear storyline where you start in your church and journey towards hell for a final stand off with the devil to save the world.

I've added features like wall running, dramatic prayer like knee slides and wall kick backflips which can all be chained to add to your Faith score which can be spent on upgrades to weapons, nuns and abilities.

I've also added Parish radio which has over 20 unique songs, parodied off real song. Some of them are:

A-Road to hell (in the trailer)

Demonbusters,

Sweet Seraphine

6-6-5,

And many more..

It's still very janky in places but with just a few maps left to do, and then will focus on the main polish of the game which will include a variety of more Basic enemies, HUD improvements, better SFX and such.

All feedback and questions welcome.

You can wishlist now on steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4841200/Nuns\_With\_Guns/
